name: gizza-ai/strip-exif
summary: Remove EXIF/GPS/XMP metadata from a JPEG or PNG

tool.description: Remove all metadata (EXIF, GPS location, XMP, IPTC, comments) from a JPEG or PNG image and return a clean copy. The pixels are NOT re-encoded — the image is byte-for-byte identical apart from the stripped metadata, so there is no quality loss. Useful for privacy before sharing photos. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). JPEG and PNG only.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
